description: Physical print only: 16 cohesion sidegrades, 11 rules clarifications and Grey Riders terminology modernization; native/Webgame unaffected.

effects.text: You may move another friendly formation in this Front one row toward its Frontline into an empty legal position.
If the opposing Frontline in this Front is empty, this Force's basic Archer Attack may target an opposing Middle Force.
effects.exposed: Archer Attack: Middle if Frontline empty

replacements.design_note: An expanded target, not a second Attack.

effects.text: You may move this formation one position into an adjacent active empty position, if legal.
While in the Middle row, this Force screens the friendly Rear Force from basic Archer Attacks even while Shaken, but not while Depleted.
effects.exposed: Screens Rear even if Shaken; not Depleted

effects.text: If played into an empty Middle position, you may swap this formation with the friendly Frontline formation here, if both placements are legal.

replacements.design_note: One-time frontline relief; still obey occupancy restrictions.

effects.text: You may move an opposing Frontline formation in this Front one row toward its Rear if that position is empty and legal.

replacements.design_note: Wolf Skirmishers no longer depend on an Archer.

effects.text: While this formation is Bonded, opposing card effects cannot move it.
effects.exposed: Enemy card effects cannot move this formation

effects.text: You may choose an opposing Bonded Formation in this Front. Return its Bond to its owner's hand.
If playing this Bond completes a Named Formation, you may immediately Maneuver it once without spending another Action or Command.
If this position contains a Force, give that Force Guarded.
While this formation is Bonded, its Name text cannot be suppressed.
While this formation is Bonded, it may Maneuver without being Named.
Draw 1 card, then put 1 card from your hand on top of your deck.

replacements.design_note: One-shot card-flow instead of blank +0 Bond.

effects.text: Look at your opponent's hand. You may then move this formation one position into an adjacent active empty position, if legal.
Reveal during Battle resolution. If your Frontline here is empty, move one friendly Middle formation here into it, if legal. That formation gets +2 Strength this Battle.
Choose one of your Kings or Captains. You may move another friendly formation in its Front to an adjacent active empty position, if legal.
Reveal during Battle resolution if this Front would tie before any Stratagems are revealed. If you have a Named Formation here and your opponent does not, you win this Front instead.
Reveal when an opposing Tactic targets one of your formations in this Front. Ignore that Tactic's effect on that formation.
Reveal during Battle resolution if this Front contains one of your Kings or Captains. Up to two other friendly formations here each get +1 Strength this Battle.
Reveal during Battle resolution if this is an outer Front. One of your Archer, Guard, or Stronghold formations here gets +2 Strength this Battle.
Reveal after one of your Raiders or Skirmishers in this Front puts a temporary negative marker on an opposing formation here. Another friendly Raider or Skirmisher here gets +2 Strength this Battle.
Reveal after one of your Riders moves from or into this Front. That Rider gets +2 Strength this Battle.
Reveal when one of your formations in this Front becomes Named. Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
Reveal during Battle resolution if this Front contains one of your Kings or Captains. Every other friendly Human formation here gets +1 Strength this Battle.
Reveal when an opposing Tactic targets one of your formations in this Front and you have an Archer here. One friendly Archer here gets +2 Strength this Battle.
Reveal when your opponent sets a Stratagem in this Front containing one of your Scouts or Seers. Look at the opposing Stratagem. Draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
Every friendly Hero formation or Named Formation gets +1 Strength this Battle. A formation that qualifies as both gets this bonus only once.

replacements.design_note: One application per formation, other card effects still stack.

effects.text: This Force may Maneuver without being Named.
This Force may Maneuver while Exhausted.

replacements.design_note: Retire the player-facing MOBILE and TIRELESS headers without altering movement permissions.
